modelTypes.label: LLM
modelTypes.meaning: A language model: it follows instructions or translates, so it can polish, reformat or translate text. Translation-only models (M2M100, NLLB-200) are listed here too; their kind says how they differ.

modelTypes.label: Decision model
modelTypes.meaning: Classifies, scores or ranks, for example to pick a command or intent; it does not write text.

modelTypes.label: Tool-calling model
modelTypes.meaning: Trained to choose a function and its arguments from what was said.

tasks.label: Decisions and routing
tasks.meaning: Pick a command or intent from what was said.

tasks.label: Text polishing
tasks.meaning: Clean up and format dictated text.

tasks.label: Tool calling
tasks.meaning: Choose a function and its arguments from what was said.

tasks.label: Translation
tasks.meaning: Translate dictated text into another language.
